definitions.explanation: To leave the ground and become airborne, said of airplanes and other aircraft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離陸|りりく}した。
⟦{悪天候|あくてんこう}→悪天候：16184_akutenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The takeoff is delayed due to bad weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{離陸|りりく}する⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧30⟦{秒|びょう}→秒：00921_byou⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took about 30 seconds from starting down the runway to takeoff.

notes:
Used specifically for aircraft leaving the ground. The noun form ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧ is commonly used on its own, as in ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (takeoff time). This is the standard aviation term and is also used in news and travel contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: takeoff time
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: takeoff preparations
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧: immediately after takeoff
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧: emergency takeoff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to land — the opposite, when an aircraft touches down
- ⟦{飛|と}び{立|た}つ→飛び立つ：19322_tobitatsu⟧: to fly off; to take flight — a more literary or general expression, also used for birds
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧: to depart — a broader term for departure that applies to any mode of transport
